gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Spacey, starlit, a bit weightless: that's Starborn, with dark lowercase floating in wide gaps. But Noto Sans Avestan keeps its curve tips apart and its x-height tall, so the heading would feel lost if made small.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-balines: Noto Sans Balinese keeps its curves open and its ascenders short. Starborn is the one for drifting, widely spaced display lettering with a heavy lowercase stripe, while the sans simply does the steady work of text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Dreamy is Starborn's whole mood, with loose spacing and a dark, thick band of lowercase. Noto Sans Bamum lets its curved strokes stop short of turning inward, giving that heading a modern, open-countered partner.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Noto Sans Bassa Vah packs a dominant midsection and a c that gapes like pliers. Starborn, with its wide gaps between letters and dark lowercase stripe, then gives Noto Sans Bassa Vah's contemporary plain sans a hazy, dreamlike heading.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-batak: Ethereal Starborn spaces its letters far apart, in a dark band. If it were set small, that airiness would shrink, while Noto Sans Batak, a plain sans with a towering x-height and a wide-open e, stays comfortable.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Dreamy, with dark lowercase and huge gaps: that's Starborn. Its strongest quality is that floating spacing, set against Noto Sans Bengali, a plain sans whose capitals barely rise above lowercase and whose letter mouths stay open.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksu: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads as a plain sans with plump, rope-tight lowercase and open apertures. Over a long page that stays approachable, while Starborn's wide-spaced, dark-banded display lettering floats above it like something dreamed.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Ethereal and spread out, Starborn leaves big gaps between its dark lowercase letters. That earns its keep on big, short headings, while Noto Sans Brahmi, a plain sans with a high mean line and open-ended curves, handles the rest.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Noto Sans Buhid reads with generous gaps where curves meet stems and a high-set x-height. Next to it, Starborn feels spacious and dreamy, its dark lowercase stripe giving the sans-serif something moody to sit beneath.
